Session date: 3:09 pm on 15 September, 2023
[D28:9] Deborah: Pictures really have a way of bringing back memories and making us appreciate the special bond we have with our loved ones. They remind me of how strong love is and how amazing human relationships can be. Just like this one.
[D28:10] Jolene: Wow, what a gorgeous pic! Do you have any special memories of that beach or just love surfing in general?
[D28:11] Deborah: That beach is super special to me. It's where I got married and discovered my love for surfing. It's always filled with joy and peace.
[D28:12] Jolene: What pleasant memories.
[...]
[D28:15] Deborah: Oh yeah! Doing this on the beach is so peaceful - the ocean, sand, and fresh air create a super relaxing atmosphere. The perfect way to take care of myself.
[D28:16] Jolene:  I like to create my own serene yoga space with candles and oils for extra chill vibes. Also, we tried a new style of meditation in Thailand - with flowers.
[D28:17] Deborah: Oh, same for me!
[...]
Session date: 1:24 pm on 17 September, 2023
[D29:3] Deborah:  Gardening is really amazing. It brings us together in such a cool way. It was awesome to share my love of plants and help people take care of the world. So, what about you? Anything new happened lately?
[D29:4] Jolene: We tried a scuba diving lesson last Friday and had an awesome time! We found a cool dive spot we can explore together. Trying new things opens up a world of adventure - maybe one day I'll be a certified diver. Anything fun going on with you?
[D29:5] Deborah: That sounds amazing, Jolene! I've been interested in underwater life, but I haven't had the chance to try scuba diving yet. Recently, I've been spending time remembering my mom. Last Sunday, I visited her old house and sat on a bench. It was a comforting experience, as if I could feel her presence guide me and remind me of her love.
[...]
[D29:23] Deborah: Wow! A special book that speaks to you and helps with self-discovery? That's awesome. Plus, having a cozy nook to chill? That's my best one!
[D29:24] Jolene: Sounds nice, Deb! A cozy nook is a must! The beach is a great place for finding peace and relaxation. Have you ever tried surfing?

Session date: 5:35 pm on 22 March, 2023
[D10:7] Deborah: Have you tried breaking it down or prioritizing the tasks?
[D10:8] Jolene: It can often feel overwhelming and difficult to figure out where to start.
[...]
[D10:18] Jolene: This gets me thinking of when I'll learn to surf. Gotta find that spare time!
[D10:19] Deborah: Surfing, huh Jolene? Chase your dreams, don't be daunted. Have you thought about the steps you can take?
[D10:20] Jolene: Definitely! I've been gathering information, watching videos, and I even got a beginners' guide to surfing. Just need to find the right time and place to get a lesson.
[D10:21] Deborah: Way to go! Taking those first steps is key. Believe in yourself and keep going!
[D10:22] Jolene: Thanks for the support! Those got me pumped to try surfing. Gonna keep pushing myself to make it happen.
[D10:23] Deborah: Keep it up, Jolene! Remember, the experience matters just as much as the end result. Step by step and have fun along the way. You can do it!
[...]
Session date: 4:30 pm on 9 April, 2023
[D12:12] Jolene: Thanks Deb! Your support means a lot. I'll keep you updated on the progress of the project.
[D12:13] Deborah: Glad my support means a lot to you! I'll always be here for you. 
[D12:14] Jolene: Take care!
[D12:15] Deborah: Enjoy your day and make time for the things that bring you joy. See ya!
[D12:16] Jolene:  I'll make sure to find time for that. Have a good one!

Session date: 9:17 am on 26 June, 2023
[D14:2] Jolene: Hey Deb! Been super hectic with internship and stuff. That retreat sounds awesome, I could definitely use a break!
[D14:3] Deborah: By the way, I tried a new pose - Dancer Pose (Natarajasana). Rate, did I succeed?
[D14:4] Jolene: You are amazing as always! Here are new photos of Seraphim in the new aquarium that I bought the day before yesterday.
[...]
[D14:14] Jolene: Stop talking about me, tell me more about your retreat.
[D14:15] Deborah: I'd rather show you a photo. This is also a new yoga pose that we tried. It is a tree pose.
[D14:16] Jolene: What's that statue in the picture?
[...]
[D14:20] Jolene: I could really use some chill time like that. Sounds so peaceful.
[D14:21] Deborah: Yeah, we all need some peaceful time to relax.
[D14:22] Jolene: Gotta run, have a nice day!
[D14:23] Deborah: See you!
Session date: 7:37 pm on 9 July, 2023
[D15:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene! I started a running group with Anna - it's awesome connecting with people who care about fitness!
[D15:2] Jolene: Cool, Deb! Glad you found some people to get fit with. I'm trying to add workouts into my studying schedule, which has been tough but fun. How about you? Any challenges with the running group?
[D15:3] Deborah: Oh, I'm having a blast with it! We help and push each other during our runs, which makes it so much easier to stay motivated.  I have a lot of my photos from this activity.

Session date: 7:37 pm on 9 July, 2023
[D15:36] Jolene: It's such a hidden gem! It makes me feel so peaceful and tranquil.
[D15:37] Deborah: Lucky you for having somewhere to relax and tune out!
[D15:38] Jolene: We'll definitely go there together sometime!
[D15:39] Deborah: We all need a timeout!
Session date: 9:26 am on 1 August, 2023
[D16:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Great news - I just started a project for a cleanup in our community and have been trying to raise funds for it. It's been amazing to see everyone come together to make a difference. How've you been? Anything new going on?
[D16:2] Jolene: Hey Debs! Congrats on your project for the community! As for me, life's been a rollercoaster lately. Last week, I had a huge setback with my project. I put in so much work and it all crashed and I lost everything. SO frustrating and depressing.
[D16:3] Deborah: Jolene, sorry to hear that. It must be really tough. I'm here for you and if I can do anything, just let me know. Is there anything that's helping you cope?
[D16:4] Jolene: Your support means a lot. Susie really helps when times get tough. Pets have been great company. Video games have also been a nice distraction.
[D16:5] Deborah: They can really provide love and comfort, especially during tough times. How did you come to have Susie?
[D16:6] Jolene: I adopted her two years ago when I was feeling lonely and wanted some company.
[D16:7] Deborah: That's great, Jolene! Animals sure have a way of bringing us happiness. They understand us and provide us with comfort. Plus, having a pet teaches us responsibility. She came at the perfect time - cherish those moments with her and find strength in her presence.
[D16:8] Jolene: Thanks Deborah. Having her around shows me I can stay strong and find joy in the small stuff.
[D16:9] Deborah: Enjoying the little things is key. Those little moments can give us a boost and push us forward. How have you been taking care of yourself lately?

Session date: 10:17 am on 20 September, 2023
[D30:6] Jolene: It was amazing! Doing yoga with that backdrop made me feel connected to nature and myself. I felt incredibly peaceful and thankful.
[D30:7] Deborah: Like, it's no wonder looking at such beauty can really help us refocus and connect with who we are. Have you ever experienced that?
[D30:8] Jolene: I remember taking a hike with my partner and coming across a waterfall oasis. Everything just felt so peaceful and my worries just disappeared. It was such a refreshing experience.
[D30:9] Deborah: Are you planning to experience it again soon?
[D30:10] Jolene: Yeah! I'm planning to get out in nature again next month. It's going to be great reconnecting with it!
[D30:11] Deborah:  Enjoy it! This photo made me think of a gorgeous blossom tree from near my home. Every spring, it was magical to watch it bloom.
[D30:12] Jolene: That sounds magical! How was it watching the tree bloom each spring?
[D30:13] Deborah: It was like admiring nature's artwork. It filled me with awe and made me appreciate the beauty of life. Even in tough times, there's hope for growth.
[D30:14] Jolene: This photo I took is a great visual representation of that idea. It reminds me that I can keep growing through any obstacles.
[D30:15] Deborah: It really captures resilience and strength. I love how you find inspiration in the small things.
[D30:16] Jolene: Thanks, Deborah! Appreciating those small things is important. It helps me remember that even when times are tough, there's always something positive to hang onto.
[D30:17] Deborah: It's a great habit. Thanks for reminding me!
[D30:18] Jolene: Sure Deb, it's great catching up. Keep on finding those beauties!
